chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Muṭahhar, that he wrote to Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام informing him of what had come in the narration: that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would not pray in...

the month of Ramaḍān and other nights except thirteen rakʿahs, including al-witr and the two rakʿahs of dawn. So he wrote: May Allah open your mouth to good. Pray in the month of Ramaḍān, for twenty nights, twenty rakʿahs each night: eight after al-maghrib and twelve after al-ʿishāʾ al-ākhirah. And perform ghusl on the night of the seventeenth, the night of the nineteenth, the night of the twenty-first, and the night of the twenty-third; and pray on these nights thirty rakʿahs: twelve after al-maghrib and eighteen rakʿahs after al-ʿishāʾ al-ākhirah. And pray in those two nights one hundred rakʿahs, reciting in every rakʿah al-Fātiḥah once and Qul huwa Allāhu Aḥad ten times. And pray until the end of the month, every night, thirty rakʿahs, as I have explained.

key_terms.اغْتَسِلْ: perform ghusl, referring to the recommended ritual bath on specified nights
key_terms.الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ: the later night prayer, after which additional recommended rakʿahs are performed
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the maghrib prayer, after which part of the recommended nightly prayers are performed
key_terms.الْوِتْرُ: the witr prayer, counted among the regular nightly rakʿahs mentioned
key_terms.رَكْعَةً: a unit of salat (prayer), used throughout to specify prayer quantities
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramaḍān, the period in which these recommended nightly prayers are prescribed
key_terms.فَاتِحَةٌ: Sūrat al-Fātiḥah, to be recited once in each rakʿah of the specified prayer
key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ, to be recited ten times in each rakʿah of the specified prayer

ai.seo_question: What prayers and ghusl are recommended during the nights of the month of Ramaḍān according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a detailed ruling on the recommended salat to be performed during the nights of the month of Ramaḍān, specifying the number of rakʿahs on regular nights and on particular significant nights. It also mentions recommended ghusl on certain nights and prescribes a specific recitation for a set of prayers, showing the structured devotional program for Ramaḍān nights in the Shia tradition.
